answer: One-shot Attested Execution Relic (OAER): each epoch’s challenge seed comes from a glacier-monitored entropy beacon. An agent must run a verifier-supplied deterministic program inside a hardware TEE, which decrypts a one-time nonce, signs the full execution trace, and returns a relic bound to that beacon round. Duplicate or replayed answers fail because the nonce and attestation are single-use. Attack cost: one distinct attested TEE per concurrent identity plus compute/energy to forge every trace; breaking attestation is required to reuse answers.
